title: When the Lab Remembers
scope: Computational benchmark; no experimentally measured materials properties or hardware validation.
uncertainty: Regime-specific Wilson 95% intervals for rates; 5000 paired campaign-seed percentile bootstrap replicates for method differences. No pooled independence assumption across regimes.
rare_event_caveat: A paired percentile interval can collapse to [0,0] if no discordant binary events are observed. This is not evidence of equivalence; inspect Wilson intervals and event counts.
first_decision_note: A hypothetical crossing during a continuing fixed-budget run, not an executed stopping policy.
